name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-workspace
description: Workspace manager for the Prometheus entity-graph ecosystem (pnpm + Turborepo + Changesets). Not published — see packages/* for the published packages.
author: Travis James <travis@prometheus.dev>

scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:release-contract && pnpm run test:ci-baseline && pnpm run test:package-contracts && pnpm run test:framework-neutral-core && pnpm run test:binding-singletons && pnpm run test:example-coverage && pnpm run test:sync-persistence && pnpm run verify:sync-persistence && pnpm run test:flutter-source-provenance && pnpm run test:tauri-plugin && pnpm run test:release-pipeline && pnpm run bdd
scripts.ci: pnpm run ci:validate && pnpm run ci:lint && pnpm run ci:typecheck && pnpm run ci:build && pnpm run ci:test && pnpm run ci:skills && pnpm run ci:security
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:release-contract && pnpm run verify:example-coverage
scripts.test:sync-persistence: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core exec vitest run src/adapters/pglite-persistence.integration.test.ts && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sync exec vitest run src/providers/loro-convergence.test.ts src/providers/loro-websocket-channel.test.ts src/providers/loro-websocket.integration.test.ts && node --test tests/release/v3-sync-persistence-path.test.mjs
scripts.test:a2ui-bridge: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react exec vitest run src/official-a2ui.test.tsx --reporter verbose && node --test tests/release/v3-a2ui-protocol-bridge.test.mjs
scripts.test:a2a-conformance: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-a2a exec vitest run src/a2a-server.test.ts --reporter verbose && node --test tests/release/v3-a2a-conformance-agent.test.mjs
scripts.test:vite-react19:unit: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management exec vitest run src/hooks/use-entity-query.test.ts src/hooks-suspense.test.tsx --reporter verbose
scripts.test:vite-react19:browser: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sync build && pnpm --filter prometheus-entity-management-vite build && pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/browser/v3-vite-react19-example.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:nextjs-app-router:browser: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management build && pnpm --filter prometheus-entity-management-nextjs build && pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/browser/v3-nextjs-app-router-example.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:agentic-a2ui:browser: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-a2a build && pnpm --filter prometheus-entity-management-agentic-a2ui build && pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/browser/v3-agentic-a2ui-example.playwright.config.ts
scripts.verify:sync-persistence: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sync build && node scripts/verify-sync-persistence.mjs
scripts.verify:a2ui-bridge: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react build && node scripts/verify-a2ui-protocol-bridge.mjs && pnpm run verify:a2ui-visual
scripts.verify:a2a-conformance: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core build && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-a2a build && node scripts/verify-a2a-conformance.mjs --report .kbd-orchestrator/phases/full-3.0-release/evidence/v3-a2a-conformance-agent/packed-consumer-report.json
scripts.verify:release-pipeline: pnpm run verify:package-contracts -- --report .kbd-orchestrator/phases/full-3.0-release/evidence/v3-release-pipeline-rc/task-3-packed-consumers.json && node scripts/verify-release-candidate.mjs --package-report .kbd-orchestrator/phases/full-3.0-release/evidence/v3-release-pipeline-rc/task-3-packed-consumers.json --report .kbd-orchestrator/phases/full-3.0-release/evidence/v3-release-pipeline-rc/task-3-verification.json --visual .kbd-orchestrator/phases/full-3.0-release/evidence/v3-release-pipeline-rc/task-3-certification.svg --require-actionlint true
scripts.dart:generate: flutter pub run melos run generate
scripts.dart:format: flutter pub run melos run format
scripts.dart:format:fix: flutter pub run melos run format:fix
scripts.dart:analyze: flutter pub run melos run analyze
scripts.dart:test: flutter pub run melos run test
scripts.dart:package: flutter pub run melos run package:check
scripts.dart:examples: flutter pub run melos run examples
scripts.dart:ci: flutter pub run melos run ci
scripts.refresh:exports: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management run refresh:exports && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sync run refresh:exports && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react run refresh:exports && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-a2a run refresh:exports && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-tauri run refresh:exports && pnpm run refresh:dart-exports
scripts.verify:skills: pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management run verify:skills && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sync run verify:skills && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react run verify:skills && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-a2a run verify:skills && pnpm --filter @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-tauri run verify:skills && pnpm run verify:dart-exports
scripts.clean: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -not -path '*/\.*' | xargs rm -rf && find . -name 'dist' -o -name '.next' | xargs rm -rf
